newsitem.title: ROMANIA: LISTED AZOMURES CUTS STAFF AFTER LOW SALES.
newsitem.headline: LISTED AZOMURES CUTS STAFF AFTER LOW SALES.

text.p: Romanian listed fertiliser maker Azomures said on Tuesday it had dismissed 200 staff after declines in domestic demand and exports.

"Demand on the local market has fallen and our current sales are around 40 percent of regular monthly deliveries of 80,000 tonnes of fertilisers," Azomures manager Horia Petra said from Tirgu Mures in the central region of Transylvania.
The company had a staff of 3,860 before the latest cuts were announced.
Azomures is listed on the first tier of the Bucharest stock exchange and has been one of the most heavily traded issues since it joined in exchange last January.
On Monday, Azomures closed 150 lei stronger at 3,150 and brokers said the announcement of job cuts would have little effect on its price.
Petra said his company's exports were also reduced from 51,000 tonnes in April to 20,000 tonnes so far this month.
"International market prices are low, while prices of fuel and transport, for instance, increased substantially," he said.
"Our situation will improve only in September, with the resumption of farming work involving fertilisers."
